'''''Festival Treats and Trinkets''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made available during the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]]. It depicted a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] cheering behind a display of various [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and trinkets, including a [[Heart/Legends|heart-shaped]] sculpture.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Festival Treats and Trinkets'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
